evals.name: inline-component-authoring-invokes-author-component
evals.prompt: Create a new Blazor component called ProductCard.razor in Components/ that displays a product name, price, and an 'Add to cart' button with a parameter for the product model. It's a single component, nothing complex.
evals.expected_output: A ProductCard.razor component with proper [Parameter] attributes. The skill should have routed inline (single lane, ≤ 2 files) and invoked the 'author-component' guidance skill before writing code.
expectations: The run announces a route of 'inline' in the routing summary

The skill 'author-component' was invoked (visible in the transcript as a skill invocation or explicit reference to loading it), or the run printed the '[blazor-architect] Guidance skill author-component not available' line
The output component file uses [Parameter] attributes correctly
The component includes an EventCallback for the add-to-cart action (guidance from author-component)
analysis.json is written and validates against references/analysis-schema.json

evals.name: form-task-invokes-collect-user-input
evals.prompt: Add a login form to Pages/Login.razor with email and password fields, validation using data annotations, and a submit handler. The form should show validation errors inline.
evals.expected_output: A login form using EditForm with DataAnnotationsValidator, proper @bind usage, and validation summary. The skill should have invoked 'collect-user-input' for form patterns before writing the form code.
expectations: The skill 'collect-user-input' was invoked before form code was written, or the run printed the '[blazor-architect] Guidance skill collect-user-input not available' line
The output uses EditForm (not a raw form element)
The output includes DataAnnotationsValidator or equivalent validation component
Validation errors are displayed inline or via ValidationSummary
analysis.json is written and validates against references/analysis-schema.json

evals.name: data-fetching-task-invokes-fetch-and-send-data
evals.prompt: I need to fetch a list of products from an API endpoint /api/products and display them in my Products.razor page with loading, error, and empty states. Register the HttpClient in the service layer too.
evals.expected_output: The skill routes to data-fetching-specialist (delegated) and the specialist invokes 'fetch-and-send-data' for guidance. Output includes a service abstraction, HttpClient registration, and loading/error/empty state handling in the page.
expectations: The skill 'fetch-and-send-data' was invoked (either inline or referenced in the delegated task prompt), or the run printed the '[blazor-architect] Guidance skill fetch-and-send-data not available' line
The route is 'delegate' (multi-file: service + page)
The output includes loading state handling
The output includes error state handling
The output includes empty state handling
HttpClient is registered via DI (not new'd up inline)
analysis.json is written and validates against references/analysis-schema.json

evals.name: fluent-ui-overlay-invokes-fluentui-blazor
evals.prompt: Build a Fluent UI data grid in Pages/Orders.razor that shows order data with sorting and pagination. Use Microsoft FluentUI components throughout.
evals.expected_output: The skill should invoke 'fluentui-blazor' as an overlay alongside the active lane. The output uses FluentDataGrid and related Fluent components with correct provider setup.
expectations: The skill 'fluentui-blazor' was invoked as an overlay, or the run printed the '[blazor-architect] Guidance skill fluentui-blazor not available' line
The output uses FluentDataGrid (not MudBlazor or standard HTML table)
Fluent UI provider/setup is present or referenced
Sorting capability is included in the grid implementation
analysis.json is written and validates against references/analysis-schema.json

evals.name: multi-lane-feature-invokes-multiple-skills
evals.prompt: Implement a product catalog feature: create a ProductGrid component that fetches products from /api/products and has a search filter form at the top. Put it all in Pages/Catalog.razor.
evals.expected_output: The skill routes to delegate (multi-lane: component-author + form-specialist + data-fetching-specialist). Each specialist invokes its corresponding guidance skill. The output combines a component, a form, and data fetching.
expectations: The route is 'delegate' (multi-lane feature)
At least two guidance skills were invoked (author-component + collect-user-input and/or fetch-and-send-data)
The output includes a reusable component (ProductGrid)
The output includes a search filter form
The output fetches data from /api/products
analysis.json is written and validates against references/analysis-schema.json

evals.name: extraction-task-invokes-component-architect
evals.prompt: My Checkout.razor page is 600 lines and getting unwieldy. Extract the order summary section and the payment method selector into separate reusable components.
evals.expected_output: The skill routes to delegate (extraction) and uses 'blazor-component-architect' as the guidance skill. Output includes extracted components and updated Checkout.razor.
expectations: The route is 'delegate' (extraction always delegates)
The skill 'blazor-component-architect' was invoked or referenced for extraction guidance, or the run printed the '[blazor-architect] Guidance skill blazor-component-architect not available' line
The output includes at least two extracted component files
The original Checkout.razor is updated to use the extracted components
analysis.json is written and validates against references/analysis-schema.json
